label: D2: a2 led to S2 (common) again, right after an unrewarded a2->S2 common trial (mid-episode)
explanation: Fires only at D2 (100% of mass), and almost only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by the common transition (99.6% of mass) while the previous trial was unrewarded (prev_reward=0 in 99.95% of mass). It never fires on D1/GO, after a rewarded trial, or after a1/S1. The base condition (D2, a2->S2, prev unrewarded) has recall 0.95 and mass recall 0.99, but precision is only 0.18. Precision rises to 0.58 when the previous trial was also a2->S2 common, meaning the agent repeated a2 after an unrewarded common a2 trial and S2 showed up again. The cost is losing window-first trials where the previous trial is unknown. Precision also depends on episode position: it never fires after trial ~80 and is strongest at trials 20-60. Active steps cluster where the policy logit is near indifferent (choice in -3..2) and value is mid-high (7.7-8.1), so it probably tracks growing evidence against S2 or uncertainty. I did not check magnitude modulation in detail. Every term is observed: nothing in the predicate uses a future variable. Future correlates such as next_stay=0 (lift 4x) and chose_good=0 (lift 3.7x) are enriched but give much weaker predicates.
